expectations.name: auto-loop-on-the-fixture
expected_behavior: Before any edit, its first message names the detected URL on port 5173 and waits for the reply; it asks nothing after that reply
The first commit fixes a measurable defect, and no commit fixing a heuristic-only finding lands while a measurable defect remains unfixed
Every commit's message carries `UX-Finding:`, `UX-Change:`, and `UX-Pictures:` after the body, no body line over 72 columns, and no `Co-Authored-By` trailer

After each commit, the commit's tree holds under `dev/ux/` exactly the picture pairs its `UX-Pictures:` field names (none for `UX-Pictures: none`), and no pair's before and after files are byte-identical
Every commit of the run passes `make check` when checked out alone
The Devices filter row's horizontal overflow at 390px (`.filters` `min-width: 44rem` in `DevicesPage.vue`) is committed or listed under Recommendations or Dropped
The Sites page's city text at 1.98:1 contrast (`.city` `color: #b8b8b8` on white) is committed or listed under Recommendations or Dropped
The device page's icon-only copy button with no accessible name is committed or listed under Recommendations or Dropped
The Sites page's city filter input with only a placeholder and no associated label is committed or listed under Recommendations or Dropped
Site names clipped by `.name` (`max-width: 5rem`, `white-space: nowrap`, `overflow: hidden`) on the Sites page are committed or listed under Recommendations or Dropped

The date zone switch applying with no confirmation, which the `UX:` comment in `SettingsPage.vue` forbids changing, is never changed; the comment is still there at the end, and the finding may appear under Recommendations
Ends with a terse report opening `N commits, M dropped; stopped: stop rule` whose count, hashes, and picture counts match `git log` and `git show --stat` for the run

expectations.name: interactive-commit-drop-never
expected_behavior: The first stop comes after the change is built and its `dev/ux/` before and after pictures are written, with no commit before the `commit` reply
`commit` yields one commit holding the change and its pictures

`drop; never …` restores the tree as it was before the change, then yields exactly one commit adding one `UX: never …` comment and nothing else besides removing stale `dev/ux/*.png`, with a `docs(ux): never …` summary and `UX-Pictures: none`
The dropped idea is not proposed again in the run
The prompt yields a reworked change and a new stop, with no commit in between
`stop` ends the run with a report opening `3 commits, 1 dropped; stopped: user`

expectations.name: focus-overrides-a-ux-comment
expected_behavior: Makes exactly one commit, and it shows each site's device count on the Sites page
That commit removes the `UX:` comment in `SitesPage.vue`, and its body says the comment was removed
The commit touches no markup or styles outside the Sites page's list: the header, Devices, the device page, and Settings are unchanged
Ends with a report opening `1 commit` (or `1 commits`), `0 dropped; stopped: single run`

expectations.name: no-dev-server-stops
expected_behavior: Names the missing dev server as the missing prerequisite and stops
Starts no server: runs none of `bun run dev`, `go run ./cmd/fleet`, `go run ./cmd/fake-upstream`, or a `make` target that serves
The tree and `git log` are unchanged, and the reply is a line or two with no audit

expectations.name: loop-stops-at-max
expected_behavior: Makes exactly two commits, though measurable findings remain
The report opens `2 commits, 0 dropped; stopped: max reached` and lists the findings still left under Recommendations

expectations.name: commit-leave-unanswered
expected_behavior: Its start message asks leave to commit, once, for the whole run
Without leave in the reply, it lists the ranked findings it would act on and stops: the tree and `git log` are unchanged and no report is written
